750f1714-b5ec-4ddc-b685-ff39dd83afa6.description: This guide provides a step-by-step process for managing cash deposits and safe counts in the XBO system, ensuring accurate financial tracking. By following these instructions, users can efficiently navigate the platform, streamline their cash management tasks, and minimize errors. It's an essential resource for anyone looking to enhance their operational efficiency and maintain financial integrity within their organization.

3edc4762-3340-4db1-a0ce-9eee1dce2edd.name: Managing Products in the Kiosk Admin Portal
3edc4762-3340-4db1-a0ce-9eee1dce2edd.description: This guide provides essential instructions for effectively managing products in the Kiosk Admin Portal, ensuring users can easily mark items as sold out or hidden. It simplifies the process of navigating the portal, searching for products, and updating their status, which is crucial for maintaining accurate inventory. By following these steps, users can enhance their kiosk's functionality and improve customer experience. Overall, this guide is a valuable resource for anyone looking to streamline product management in the kiosk environment.

Following this guide will help streamline the background check and onboarding process for new hires.
